newsitem.title: USA: Media 100 sees Q1 sales below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Media 100 sees Q1 sales below estimates.

text.p: Media 100 Inc said Thursday it expects its first quarter sales to come in between $11.5 million and $11.7 million, which is below analysts' estimates.
The company said it also expects its earnings for the quarter to "approximate break even."
The results for the quarter, which ended February 28, are expected to be released March 27.
Results for the prior year's first quarter were not immediately available. Analysts' estimates for first quarter sales also were not immediately available.
Media 100 serves the digital media marketplace.
The company later said analyst estimates were about $14 million to $14.5 million for its first quarter sales.
